data.method_note: Compatibility here is what each gem version declares in its gemspec, read from the RubyGems compact index. A gem with no declared Rails dependency is unknown, not compatible.

status_meaning.declared-compatible: The gem's declared range admits the hop version. Where open_ended is true the range has no upper bound and was written before the hop version existed.
status_meaning.no-declared-constraint: The gem does not depend on any framework gem, so its gemspec says nothing either way. Most such gems never touch the framework. Unknown, not compatible.

note: Declared constraints from the package registry, cached under cache/http.
